latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generate step-by-step AI video guides for essential home improvement tasks.

- Produces detailed DIY videos for plumbing, electrical, painting, flooring, drywall, and seasonal maintenance tasks.
- Emphasizes safety, tool identification, and clear step-by-step demonstrations from a first-person perspective.
- Designed to save homeowners money on repairs and upgrades by increasing DIY confidence and skills.
- Allows users to define project type, skill level, and customize video format for tailored guidance.
- Comprehensive video content covers diagnosis, repair, prevention tips, and when to call a professional.
